title: Made PSX announcements queryable in chat
points: Added a dedicated `psx_announcements` retrieval lane so the router can intentionally pull ticker-specific exchange notices instead of mixing them into annual-report filing pages.

Announcement retrieval now uses `psx_announcements_fts` for BM25 search over material disclosures, board meeting notices/results, corporate briefing notices, unusual movement notices, dividends, book closure, and other PSX announcements.
The source panel now distinguishes statements, filings, announcements, and other unstructured text so users can see what kind of evidence supports an answer.
Announcement PDFs and first-page thumbnails are hosted under `source.psxgpt.com/ANNOUNCEMENTS/...` and `ANNOUNCEMENT_THUMBNAILS/...` when the pipeline publishes announcement assets.
